entries.def:
ἄμετρος, -ον
(μέτρον), 
without measure: adverbially, εἰς τὰ ἄ., excessively, 2Co.10.13; 10.15†
(AS)

ἀμήν, indecl. (Heb. אָמֵן, verbal adj. fr. אמן, to prop. ni., be firm), 
[in LXX: 1Ch.16.36, I Est.9.46, Neh.5.13; 8.6, Tob.8.8; 14.15, 3Ma.7.23, 4Ma.18.24 (elsewhere ''א is rendered ἀληθινός, Isa.65.16 ἀληθῶς, Jer.28.6; γένοιτο, Num.5.22, Deu.27.15ff., 1Ki.1.36, Psa.40 (41):13 71 (72):19 105 (106):48, Jer.11.5)*.] 
__1. As adj. (cf. Is, l.with), ὁ ἀ., Rev.3.14. 
__2. As adv., 
__(a) in solemn assent to the…

ἀμήτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ἡ
(μήτηρ), without a mother (frequently in Gk. writers of the gods): ἀπάτωρ ἀ. 
of one without recorded genealogy, Heb.7.3 (cf. MM, VGT, see word) 
(AS)

ἀ-μίαντος, -ον
(μιαίνω), [in LXX: Wis.3.13; 4.2; 8.20, 2Ma.14.36 2Mac.15.34 * ;] 
undefiled, free from contamination (in π., of αἰθήρ; MM, VGT, see word): Heb.7.26; 13.4, 1Pe.1.4, Jas.1.27.†
SYN.: ἄμωμος, ἄσπιλος (Cremer, 784) (AS)

Ἀμιναδάβ, ὁ indecl. (Heb עַמִּינָדָב), 
Amminadab: Mat.1.4, Luk.3.33 (WH om.).†
(AS)

ἄμμος, -ου, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for חוֹל ;] 
sand, sandy ground: Mat.7.26, Rom.9.27, Heb.11.12, Rev.18.1, Rev.20.8.†
(AS)

ἀμνός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for כֶּבֶשׂ ;] 
a lamb: figuratively, of Christ (DCG, ii, 620b), Jhn.1.29, 36, Act.8.32" (LXX), 1Pe.1.19 (cf. ἀρνίον; Cremer, 102, 635).†
(AS)

ἀμοιβή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀμείβομαι, to repay); [in Aq., Sm.: Pro.12.14, al. ;] 
requital, recompense: 1Ti.5.4 (for illustration from τ.. see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

ἄμπελος, -ου, ἡ 
[in LXX for גֶּפֶן ;] 
vine: Mat.26.29, Mrk.14.25, Luk.22.18 Jas.3.12; figuratively, of Christ, Jhn.15.1, 4-5; of his enemies (on the usage here, see MM, VGT, see word): Rev.14.18-19.†
(AS)

ἀμπελουργός, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ 
[in LXX for כֹּרֵם ;] 
a vine dresser: Luk.13.7.†
(AS)
